name: Minshina's Skull
summary: On the Echo Isles, Minshina's Skull holds the bound soul of Minshina, a Darkspear troll and brother of Master Gadrin. Zalazane trapped him there after driving the tribe from the isles, and uses the skull to fuel dark rituals.

sections.title: A Trapped Spirit
sections.body: Minshina was captured and slain when Zalazane seized the Echo Isles and drove out the Darkspear. The traitorous witch doctor bound his victim's soul to Minshina's severed skull instead of letting him pass into death. The skull lies within a circle of power on the southernmost isle, tethering Minshina to Zalazane's magic. Tormented by dreams of his brother calling to him, Master Gadrin seeks brave travelers to enter the occupied islands, reclaim the skull, and break Zalazane's hold over Minshina's spirit.

faq.answer: Minshina was a Darkspear troll and the brother of Master Gadrin of Sen'jin Village. He was murdered amid Zalazane's betrayal on the Echo Isles.

faq.q: Why is Minshina's soul trapped in his skull?
faq.answer: Zalazane bound Minshina's spirit inside his severed head with dark magic. The skull was placed in a circle of power on the main isle, keeping Minshina's soul bound to Zalazane's will instead of passing to the ancestors.
The skull lies on the largest, southernmost isle of the Echo Isles. It rests atop a hill in a circle of power with candles, ritual markers, and other skulls, guarded by Zalazane's thralls.

faq.q: What happens when the skull is brought to Master Gadrin?
faq.answer: When you return the skull to Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village, the dark enchantment breaks. Minshina's spectral form appears briefly, bows in gratitude, and departs peacefully for the realm of the ancestors.

angles.text: For the Darkspear, Zalazane's desecration of Minshina violates ancestral tradition. Recovering his skull is a matter of tribal honor.
Recovering the skull strikes an early blow against Zalazane's hold over the Echo Isles, just off Durotar's coast.
